stages.effectText: Damage dealt to enemies under an Elemental Burst effect increased to 110%
Whenever Burn burst is triggered on an enemy, immediately deals 390% ATK as Elemental Damage to that enemy, recovers HP equal to 12% of Max HP, and ATK +5% for 10s
Whenever Burn burst is triggered on an enemy, immediately deals 420% ATK as Elemental Damage to that enemy, recovers HP equal to 15% of Max HP, and ATK +10% for 10s
SP recovery +0.2/sec when there are enemies under the burst effect of Elemental Injury within range

When defeated, becomes downed instead and gains 6000 Barrier ; cannot attack or be healed while downed, but recovers 4% HP per second, and deals 100% ATK Arts damage and 20% of the Arts damage dealt as Burn to the attacker when hit; once HP is full, revives and stuns nearby enemies for 5s, then gains 4 SP

When defeated, becomes downed instead and gains 6000 Barrier ; cannot attack or be healed while downed, but recovers 4% HP per second, and deals 120% ATK Arts damage and 30% of the Arts damage dealt as Burn to the attacker when hit; once HP is full, revives and stuns nearby enemies for 5s, then gains 8 SP
